name: @agenetes/agentlet-host
description: L2 transport host: embeds @agentlet/server into a Fastify app and supervises the forked agentlet daemon. Wraps @agentlet/server whole (the §6.1 internal transport/control re-split is deferred). All host layout knowledge (connection token, data dir, daemon entry path) is injected via mountAgenetes().
